title: OpenCredentials
tagline: OpenCredentials Access uses credentials to gate access to data
description: This project uses OpenCredentials and TinyCloud Protocol to gate access to content based on a user's Credentials. These credentials allow non-crypto users and businesses to be able to issue portable credentials that lives with individual users. These credentials can be used by organizations to show that someone has done a course, accomplished something, has a certian permission or status. They use the same cryptography
how_its_made: This project uses TinyCloud + OpenCredentials + Lit. OpenCredentials lets user's self-issue credentials and store them in their TinyCloud. They can then access these credentials in the OpenCredentials LIT Access app. These credentials are then used alongside a signature from them by a Lit Protocol action to decrypt data based on your access.
